articles.title: Macron and Carney announce closer France-Canada ties amid Trump tensions
articles.highlight: 法国与加拿大领导人承诺加强联系，以应对不断升级的地缘政治紧张、气候变化和民主价值观的侵蚀。
articles.summary: 法国总统马克龙与加拿大总理卡尼在加拿大近海的法国属地圣皮埃尔和密克隆会晤，承诺加强法加联系。此次会晤正值加拿大在与美国进行贸易战之际寻求更紧密的欧盟关系，而数周前特朗普曾发布图片，将加拿大及北美多地覆盖在美国国旗之下。对关注国际格局的读者来说，这提供了观察美国压力下盟友关系调整的一个切口。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键点：法加借首次此类会晤释放加强合作信号，背景是美加贸易摩擦及特朗普相关言论带来的外部压力。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Two leaders meet in French territory off Canada as Ottawa seeks stronger relations with EU while fighting trade war with US The leaders of France and Canada have pledged closer ties to grapple with rising geopolitical tensions, climate change and the erosion of democratic values, after ⁠they met in a ⁠French territory off Canada’s Atlantic coast. The two leaders’ visit to Saint-Pierre ​and Miquelon – the first by a French president since 2014 and the first by a Canadian prime minister – came just weeks ⁠after Donald Trump posted an image showing the islands, as well as all of Canada and other countries in North America, covered by the US flag.

articles.title: Autofocus: The Productivity System That Treats Your To-Do List Like a River
articles.highlight: 伯克曼观察到，问题在于待办清单是一只看似每天都要清空、却永远无法真正清空的桶。
articles.summary: 这篇文章借《Time Management for Mortals》作者奥利弗·伯克曼的观点，讨论人们常把待办清单当作每天必须清空的桶，但它其实永远清不空。文章由此引出 Autofocus 生产力系统：把待办清单当作一条持续流动的河流来管理，而不是一个必须归零的容器。对于总被未完成任务困扰的人，它提供了一个重新理解效率与注意力的角度。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启发：不要执着于每天清空待办清单，而要接受任务会持续流动，并据此调整优先顺序和管理注意力。

en.highlight: Burkeman observes that the problem is that the to-do list is a bucket that never entirely empties.

articles.title: The Measure of a Life Well Lived: Henry Miller on How to Grow Old and the Secret of Remaining Young at Heart
articles.highlight: 若能一再坠入爱河，若能宽恕也能遗忘，若能不变得尖酸、暴躁、苦涩与愤世，那你已经赢了一半。
articles.summary: 这篇文章借亨利·米勒八十岁时的思考，谈如何老去以及如何在心里保持年轻。核心不在年龄，而在是否仍能去爱、去宽恕，并避免变得尖酸刻薄与愤世嫉俗。对非技术读者来说，它是关于人生韧性与心态的简短提醒，值得一读。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：衡量人生质量的，往往不是成就清单，而是年老时是否仍保有爱与宽恕的能力，并拒绝让心变得苦涩。
articles.sourceExcerpt: "If you can fall in love again and again ... if you can forgive as well as forget, if you can keep from growing sour, surly, bitter and cynical, man you've got it half licked."

en.highlight: If you can fall in love again and again, forgive as well as forget, and keep from growing sour, surly, bitter and cynical, you've got it half licked.
en.summary: This article draws on Henry Miller's reflections at eighty to ask how to grow old and how to stay young at heart. The point is not age, but whether you can still love and forgive, and avoid becoming sour or cynical. For non-technical readers, it is a short reminder about resilience and mindset, and worth reading.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway: the measure of a life is often not a list of achievements, but whether, in old age, you still keep the capacity to love and forgive and refuse to let your heart grow bitter.

articles.sourceExcerpt: IEEE TRANSACTIONS ON CONSUMER ELECTRONICS, VOL. XX, 2026 1 Bio-MF: Low-Latency and High-Fidelity EEG-to-fNIRS Cross-Modal Generation for Hybrid Motor-Imagery Brain–Computer Interfaces Boyuan Zhao, Sifan Zhang, and Luping Chen Abstract—Hybrid motor-imagery brain-computer interfaces (MI-BCIs) combining EEG and fNIRS can outperform EEG- only systems by exploiting complementary electrophysiological and hemodynamic information. To obtain such hybrid infor- mation when paired EEG-fNIRS acquisition is unavailable or inconvenient, recent studies have focused on EEG-to-fNIRS cross- modal generation.

articles.summary: 这篇文章是作者为美国国会听证会准备的证词扩写版，主题是开放模型领域当前的权力格局，也就是各方力量对比与主导权归属。它值得一读，因为把技术问题放到了政策与竞争的语境中，能帮助非技术读者理解开放模型为什么会被拿到国会层面讨论。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键点在于：开放模型的格局不是单纯的技术优劣问题，而是涉及产业与政策主导权的力量对比，判断时要把技术指标和地缘、监管因素放在一起看。

en.highlight: This is the expanded form of a testimony I prepared for Congress on the balance of power in open models.
en.summary: This piece is an expanded version of testimony prepared for a U.S. congressional hearing, focused on the current balance of power among open models—who holds influence and how the competing forces line up. It is worth reading because it places a technical topic in a policy and competition context, helping non-technical readers see why open models are being debated at the congressional level.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway: the state of open models is not just a question of technical merit but of industrial and policy leverage, so technical benchmarks should be read alongside geopolitical and regulatory factors.
